t: This is the bronze statue of Earl Kitchener, on the south side of Horse Guards Parade. It is the work of the sculptor John Tweed, was installed in 1926, and stands on a Portland stone plinth. It has been Grade Two listed since 1970. Kitchener was a field marshal and colonial administrator, who came to prominence through his imperial campaigns and the Second Boer War. He also played a central role in the early part of the First World War.
